answer: Continuity is what a farm cannot buy. Each seat keeps a hash-chained sea log: one page an epoch listing the seed, a violet seal pressed with the die held at harbour forge, and the digest of the page beneath it. Backdate a page and every later link breaks, so the chain voids it. Two licensed witnesses must countersign inside the hour, 40 POA each. Minting 1,000 seats means 1,000 empty chains, no history, 80,000 POA in witness fees before a first payout, and a 60,000 POA bond slashed once one link fails audit. An old jetty earns trust because barnacle follows barnacle on the same piling.
